purpose: Lightweight, machine-readable seed for the Constitutional Identity & Resource Protocol's forward-compliance/backward-compatibility migration rule (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md). Prevents future patchwork by naming, once, what each component's relationship to the target Person-Persona-iQube protocol is. This is NOT a migration project tracker — do not add work items here; add only classification.

entries.current_model: Read-only identity/personhood-continuity resolver (kybe_identity/agent_root_identity -> didqubes supertype tables). No authorization semantics.
Single server resolver + client personaFetch/usePersonaSpine for the active Persona.
Load-bearing resource/participation-authorization engine (access_grants/access_invitations) for passport, research-lab, venture-lab, metame-studio, developer-studio domains.
entries.risk: high if touched carelessly — many surfaces depend on it directly
entries.migration_trigger: never without demonstrated behavioral equivalence + default-deny parity tests (CLAUDE.md Migration rule)

entries.risk: low as a composer, but every consumer (Workspace UI, dossier resolver) inherits its gate — changes here are high blast-radius
entries.migration_trigger: none — extend by composition only, per its own header

entries.current_model: Single gate for content/asset delivery decisions (free/credential/ownership/payment).

entries.component: Supabase RLS policies on identity/resource tables
entries.current_model: Enabled broadly; policies sampled are service_role-gated or absent — real per-user authorization lives in TypeScript, not Postgres policy.
entries.target_protocol: Storage-level enforcement backstop, never the primary decision point
entries.risk: medium — RLS must never be weakened to compensate for an application projection defect (CLAUDE.md protocol rule)
entries.migration_trigger: only if a table's application-layer gate is found insufficient on its own

entries.current_model: Canonical DVN receipt writer/pipeline; personaId is T0, never serialized; hashed persona reference only on-chain.
entries.risk: low; DVN pipeline itself is separately marked CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE in CLAUDE.md

entries.current_model: Real Standing computation/accrual (standingCore.ts, standingScore.ts, buildStandingGraph.ts) exists and runs.
entries.target_protocol: Standing accrues to personhood (KybeDID), retaining Persona/context provenance
entries.risk: medium — DiDQube-anchored personhood wiring is Phase-4/in-progress per RES-2026-09-07-DIDQUBE-PHASE-4-STANDING-CONSUMER-MIGRATION-001
entries.migration_trigger: DiDQube Phase 4 Standing-consumer migration completion (already scheduled, not new work created by this register)

entries.current_model: Deliberately segregated bearer-session identity channel (ths_ tokens), bridged into Persona Spine via getActivePersonaByPublicRef rather than duplicating it.
entries.target_protocol: Adapter into Persona/DiDQube layer for an external transport
entries.risk: low — the segregation is intentional and documented

entries.current_model: Per-artifact disclosure-gated exchange resolver (getExchangeView, listMyExchanges) over reciprocal_exchanges.
Normalizes Horizen's own external agent-identity string formats; consumes personaId as opaque, resolves no identity of its own.
entries.target_protocol: External-system adapter into the Persona/Delegation/DVN layers
